user.title: Ingredient Extractor
user.description: Photograph a recipe or paste its link and its ingredients are added to a todo list. Create an API key at console.anthropic.com (usage is billed by Anthropic, typically a fraction of a cent per photo).

data_description.provider: The service that reads the photo.
data_description.api_key: Your Anthropic API key, from console.anthropic.com under API keys.
data_description.model: Pick a suggested model or type any model ID. Haiku is fast and cheap; Sonnet is more accurate on messy handwriting.

reconfigure.title: Update Ingredient Extractor
reconfigure.description: Enter a new API key or change the model. The key is checked before saving.

error.invalid_auth: The API key was rejected. Check it at console.anthropic.com.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the AI provider. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_model: That model was not found for your account.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

data.share_enabled: Add recipes shared to the Home Assistant app

data_description.api_key: Leave blank to keep the current key. A new key is checked with Anthropic before it is saved.
data_description.model: Pick a suggested model or type any model ID.
data_description.todo_entity: Extracted ingredients are added to this todo list.
data_description.share_enabled: Share a recipe link from the Android Home Assistant app and its ingredients are added to the list. You get a notification when it is done.
data_description.auto_sort: After a photo or link is added, order the open items by shop section. You can also sort any time with the ingredient_extractor.sort_list action.

sort_list.name: Sort shopping list
sort_list.description: Order the open items on the list by shop section. Items not seen before are classified by the AI first.
